events.name: Alabama Ballet Presents American Portraits
events.info: In celebration of America's 250th anniversary, American Portraits is a vibrant mixed repertory program honoring the nation's artistic spirit. The program features Stars and Stripes Pas de Deux by George Balanchine, a dazzling display of neoclassical energy and patriotic flair. Also included is To Heal by Christopher Stuart, a moving work set to Gospel music reflecting faith and resilience. Appalachian Spring by Paul Vasterling brings Copland's iconic score to life with warmth and optimism inspired by the American frontier. Rounding out the program is Dispersal by Christopher Stuart, a contemporary exploration of motion and connection. Together, these works celebrate generations of American choreography and creativity.
events.pleaseNote: If you have celebrated your 2nd birthday, you must have a ticket.

venues.name: BJCC Theatre

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The BJCC Central Ticket Office is open Monday through Friday 9:00am to 4:00pm CT. The Central Ticket Office is located at Legacy Arena, Entry A 1898 9th Ave North, Birmingham, AL 35203. The Concert Hall and Theatre Box Office opens two hours before scheduled start time for most events. Hours may vary for some events.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call is only available the day of the event at the Concert Hall/Theatre Box Office. For most events, will call opens two hours before the scheduled start time. Hours may vary for some events. Please bring a picture ID, the actual credit card used to purchase the tickets, and your order number.

venues.parkingDetail: Visit www.BJCC.org/plan-your-visit/directions-and-parking for a printable map and to pre-purchase parking. Parking prices vary by event and date. We aim to make navigating the BJCC campus simple using clear directions. With various parking options for events, conventions, and meetings, planning ahead ensures a smoother arrival. Since multiple events often occur simultaneously, arrive early to avoid long parking and entry lines.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Accessible seating is available throughout the venue and can be purchased on Ticketmaster.com. Guests requiring accessible seating are guaranteed the ability to purchase at least one (1) companion seat. Subject to availability, guests requiring wheelchair seating may purchase up to a total of three (3) companion seats in the same row and contiguous with the wheelchair seat. If contiguous seats have already been sold, seats as close as possible to the wheelchair seat and adjacent companion seat will be offered. If you purchased a ticket in the fixed seating area but require an accessible seat, the Ticket Office may be able to assist you by relocating your ticket to an accessible seat. Please contact the Ticket Office at CTO@bjcc.org if you have any questions or require assistance purchasing tickets. Tickets are subject to availability.

generalInfo.generalRule: Prohibited items include, but are not limited to laser pointers, weapons, glass containers, cans, chains, outside food or beverage, professional recording devices for photography, video or audio. See a full list of prohibited items at https://www.bjcc.org/plan-your-visit/bag-policy/ Bags must be CLEAR plastic, vinyl or PVC and not exceed 12"x6"x12". Bags cannot be tinted with color or include oversized content that prevents visibility into the clear bag. Only non-clear bags smaller than 5"x7" will be permitted entry. The venue reserves the right to search all guests entering the arena and to refuse entry at the discretion of management. Smoking is prohibited inside the Concert Hall/Theatre and only allowed in designated smoking areas outside of the building.
generalInfo.childRule: For most events, children who have celebrated their 2nd birthday are required to have a ticket. For show specific age restrictions that may supersede our standard policy, visit www.bjcc.org/events

events.name: "Weird Al" Yankovic: Bigger & Weirder 2026 Tour
events.info: Weird Al brings his legendary full-production multimedia comedy rock show back to the concert stage with the BIGGER & WEIRDER 2026 Tour, playing his iconic hits as well as some never-performed-live-before fan favorites. Al?s long-time band is joined by four additional players to create a super-sized concert experience. ?Weird Al? Yankovic is the biggest-selling comedy recording artist in history. A 5-time Grammy Award winner, he is best known for his parodies of the biggest musical artists over the last 4 decades, including Madonna, Michael Jackson, Taylor Swift, Queen, U2 and Lady Gaga, all with their personal blessings. His many hits include ?Amish Paradise,? ?Eat It,? ?Like a Surgeon,? ?Smells Like Nirvana,? ?Word Crimes,? and the platinum-selling ?White & Nerdy.? His last album Mandatory Fun is the only comedy album in history to debut at #1 on the Billboard Top 200.
